related_questions.question: What is the ICD-10 code for history of tonsillar cancer?

text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10-CM code for malignant neoplasm of the tonsil is C09.9, which represents a malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of the tonsil. For personal history of malignant neoplasms, including those of the tonsils, the code Z85.818 (personal history of malignant neoplasm of other sites of lip, oral cavity, and pharynx) or Z85.819 (personal history of malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of lip, oral cavity, and pharynx) may be used.

list.title: C09.9:
list.snippet: This code is used specifically for malignant neoplasms (cancers) of the tonsils when the specific location within the tonsil is not specified, according to ICD-10 data.

list.title: Z85.818:
list.snippet: This code is used when a person has a history of cancer in other sites of the lip, oral cavity, and pharynx, which includes the tonsils. This code is more specific than Z85.819 because it identifies the location of the prior cancer, according to the AAPC.

list.title: Z85.819:
list.snippet: This code is used when a person has a history of cancer in the lip, oral cavity, and pharynx, but the specific site (like the tonsils) is not specified, according to the AAPC.

list.title: Z85.8:
list.snippet: This code is a broader category for personal history of malignant neoplasms of other organs and systems. It's a less specific code and might be used if the exact location of the previous cancer is unknown.

related_questions.question: What is the ICD-10 code for personal history of cancer?

text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10 code for personal history of malignant neoplasm (cancer) is Z85. This code is used to indicate that a patient has a history of cancer, regardless of whether the cancer is currently in remission or has been treated. Z85 is further specified with subcategories to indicate the specific site of the cancer, for example, Z85.3 is for personal history of malignant neoplasm of the breast.

list.snippet: Z85: This is the main code for "Personal history of malignant neoplasm".
Z85.0: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the digestive organs.
Z85.1: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the trachea, bronchus, and lung.
Z85.2: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of other respiratory and intrathoracic organs.
Z85.3: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the breast.
Z85.4: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the genitourinary organs.
Z85.5: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the eye, brain, and other parts of the nervous system.
Z85.6: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the thyroid and other endocrine glands.
Z85.7: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of the lymphoid, hematopoietic, and related tissues.
Z85.8: This subcategory is for malignant neoplasms of other organs and systems.
Z85.9: This subcategory is for unspecified malignant neoplasm.

text_blocks.snippet: When using these codes, it's important to be as specific as possible. If the patient's cancer history is known, use the appropriate subcategory (e.g., Z85.3 for breast cancer). If the specific type of cancer is not known, use the unspecified code (Z85.9).

text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10 code for personal history of tonsil cancer is Z85.21.

list.snippet: Z85: Personal history of malignant neoplasm
.21: Specifies that the neoplasm (cancer) is of the tonsil
If the patient has had multiple tonsil cancers, the code Z85.22 (personal history of malignant neoplasm of nasal cavities, middle ear, and accessory sinuses) may be used.
If the patient has had a benign tonsil tumor, the code Z86.018 (personal history of other benign neoplasm) may be used.
If the patient has had a history of other types of head and neck cancer, the appropriate ICD-10 codes for those cancers may also be used.
